query:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM file f
                       JOIN file_tag_rel ftr ON f.id = ftr.file_id
                       JOIN file_tag ft ON ftr.tag_id = ft.id
                       WHERE ft.name = ?1 AND (?2 IS NULL OR f.is_private = 0 OR f.user_id = ?2)
                         AND f.original_name LIKE ?3 ESCAPE '\'
